content: Ayhuda Asay Phawuloosa Mootides
Ichchashu gallassafe guye qeeseta halaqa Hanaaniyay issi issi cimataranne Xarxuloosa geetettiza xabaqaara Qisaariya bides; isttika dere ayssiza Filkisekko shiiqidi Phawuloosa mootida.
Phawuloosi xeygetti shiiqiin Xarxuloosi iza, «Bonchcho Filkisee! Nuni ne baggara daro saroteth demmidos; ne lo7o aysonka nu deres lo7eteththi beettides.
«Hessa ne lo7o oosoza nu awan gidiin aydekka dhoqqu gida bonchchoranne galatara ekkoos.
Ta ha7i nena gam7isonttanne daaburssontta qaanththara nees yootizayssa kiyateththan nu gizayssa ne siyana mala woossoos.
«Hayssi addezi nuus iita harge gidides; alamen diza Ayhudata ubbaa bolla meto medhdhees; Naaziraawe geetettiza wordo asata kaaleththiza waannay iza.
Izi Xoossa Keeththe tunisana gishin nu iza oykkidos. [Nu wogaa mala nu iza bolla pirdana qoppidos;
gido attiin wottadarata halaqata azazizayssi Lusiyoosi gakkidi nu kusheppe iza wolqqara woththi ekkides.
Iza mootiza asaykka neekko yaana mala azazides.] Hayssi nu iza bolla shiishshida mootozi wuri tumu gididayssa neni ne baggara iza oychcha gakkanaas dandayaasa» gi mootides.
Hinko Ayhuda asatikka, «Ee hayssi yo7ozi wurikka tumukko» giidi ammanettida.
Phawuloosi Bana Ashshana Oge Medhdhides

Dere ayssiza Filkisey Phawuloosi haasayana mala ba kushera malati bessides; Phawuloosikka, «Neni daro layth hayssa dereza ayssizaade gididayssa ta eriza gishshas ta bolla shiiqida mootozas ta nees ufayssan zaaro shiishshays.
Ta Xoossas goynnanaas Yerusalaame biin hach tammanne nam7u gallassafe daronttayssa neni ne baggara eranaas dandayaasa.
Xoossa Keeththan gidiin Ayhudata Woosa Keeththan woykko katama giddon ta oonarakka palamettishin woykko dere giddon meto medhdhishin tana demmibeettenna.
Ha7i ta bolla istti shiishshida mootozas ay markkaka shiishshanaas dandayettenna.
«Gido attiin ta nees qonccisana koyzay istti wordo giza Godaa ogera nu aawantta Xoossaas goynnayssinne Muse wogaaninne nabeta maxaafan xaafettidayssaka ubbaa ammanays.
Isttika ufays ooththiza mala tanikka nagaranchchatinne xilloti hayqoppe dendanayssa Xoossan ammanettays.
Hessa gishshas Xoossa sinththaninne asa sinththan sidhey baynda hanoy taas daana mala ubba wode minnays.
«Ta Yerusalaameppe keziin taas daro layth gididaappe guye ta dere asaas maado miishshenne Xoossas imettiza miishshe ekka yadis.
Tana istti Xoossa Keeththan demmiday ta hessa gaththishinna; he wode ta geeyza wogaa polishin tanara daro asi deenna; ooshshinne shiroykka deenna.
Gido attiin Iisiyappe yida issi issi Ayhuda asati deettes; isttaskka tana mootos gaththizaazi dizaa gidikko ne sinththan tana mootetto.
Hessafe guye tani duulataa sinth shiiqikko ta ooththida qohoy diikko he asati yootetto.

Tana hayssas gaththida gaasoykka ta istta giddon eqqada, ‹Hayqqidaytas denththi dees› ga yootida gishshas, ‹Hach pirdas intte sinth shiiqadis› gaada ta qaalaa dhoqqu histta yootadis attiin hara tani ooththida miishshi deenna» gides.
Filkisey Godaa oge lo7eththi eriza gishshas, «Wottadarata halaqata azazizayssi Lusiyoosi yiza wode ta intte yo7oza gishshas qasho gidiza yo7o immana» giidi istta yeddides.
Phawuloosa naagiza mato halaqay, «Iza daro waayisontta lo7eththa naaga; iza laggeti izas koshshiza miish ekki yiikko diggofa» gides.
Filkise Sinththinne Dirussilla Sinth Phawuloosa Shiiqo
Guuththa wodeppe kaallidi Filkisey Ayhuda as gidida ba machcheyo Durissillara yides; Phawuloosakka xeygidi Yesus Kirstoosan ammano gishshas izi yootishin siyides.
Phawuloosi xilloteththa gishshas, asi barkka bana haaro gishshassinne buroppe yaana pirdaa gishshas yootiin Filkisey babbidi, «Ha7i ne ba; hara wode taas giigshin ta nena xeyga ekkana» gides.
Filkisey Phawuloosappe gubbo ekkanaas ufays ooththi naagida gishshas daro wode gakkanaas xeygi xeygi haasayssides.
Nam7u layththafe guye Phorqiyoosa Fisxoosi Filkise sohon shuumettides; Filkisey Ayhudata ufayssanaas koyidi Phawuloosa qashoson aggaagides.
